title: Restricted Fourier estimator cost
statement: For a finite coordinate set $J\subseteq\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, a subset $S\subseteq J$, and a sample size $m\in\mathbb{N}$, the estimator cost has $0$ random-example calls, $2m$ membership queries, and $3mn+m(2+w(J,S))+(m+1)$ units of work, where $w(J,S)$ is the restricted Fourier weight observation work.
caveat: The observation-work quantity is referenced by the Lean definition but its defining formula is not included in the supplied statement.
